sections.heading: Glass Door Repair Services for Gaithersburg Businesses
sections.body: Commercial glass doors are the first impression clients and tenants have of your property, and a cracked panel, broken hinge, or misaligned frame can undermine both security and curb appeal. We provide full-service glass door repair for storefronts, office buildings, medical facilities, retail centers, and multi-tenant properties throughout Gaithersburg. Whether you manage a high-traffic entrance near Lakeforest Mall or oversee a corporate campus on the city's thriving tech corridor, our technicians arrive equipped to assess and repair damage efficiently. We work with tempered glass, laminated glass, insulated units, and standard commercial pane configurations. Our goal is always to restore full function and appearance with minimal disruption to your business operations, often completing repairs in a single visit.

sections.heading: Storefront Door Frame and Hardware Repair
sections.body: A glass panel is only as reliable as the frame and hardware supporting it. Bent aluminum frames, worn pivot hinges, failing door closers, broken panic hardware, and damaged thresholds are all common issues in high-traffic commercial environments. Left unaddressed, these problems accelerate wear on the glass itself and can create safety concerns for employees and visitors. Our Gaithersburg commercial door repair team handles full frame realignment, hardware replacement, and threshold repairs for all standard commercial door systems. We carry a wide inventory of replacement components so we can source the right parts quickly. Whether your property is a neighborhood strip center in the Kentlands area or a larger mixed-use development, we bring the tools and experience to get your doors operating smoothly again.

sections.heading: Automatic and Sliding Commercial Door Repair
sections.body: Automatic sliding doors and swing door operators are essential features in medical offices, grocery stores, pharmacies, and hospitality properties across Gaithersburg. When sensors malfunction, motors fail, or tracks become obstructed, the impact on customer flow and accessibility is immediate. Our technicians are experienced in diagnosing and repairing automatic door systems, addressing issues with operators, sensing mats, overhead sensors, and door tracks. We also service manual sliding glass door systems commonly found in commercial storefronts and office suite entries. Keeping these entry systems operational is especially important for properties that must maintain accessible entrances for all visitors. We prioritize prompt service calls so that a malfunctioning automatic door does not leave your business exposed or inconvenient for customers and tenants.
